info.title: PACT Developer Platform v1
info.description: Solana Devnet only. Public lookup is not authentication. No server signing/broadcast or registry. Authentication supports an explicitly opted-in single persistent Node process; multi-instance/serverless auth is unsupported.

get.description: Read verified public offer parameters and commitment; no metadata preimage.

409.description: Offer inactive or wallet already licensed.

503.description: RPC, freshness, configuration, busy reader or disabled authentication failure; fail closed.
